record.question: In an ischemic stroke (e.g., acute brain infarction), how does the movement of water molecules typically change, and how does it appear on a standard DWI image?
options: Water movement increases; appears dark (low signal).
Water movement is unrestricted; appears bright.
Water movement is restricted; appears bright (high signal).
Water movement is restricted; appears dark (low signal).
record.explanation: Answer C: Water movement is restricted; appears bright (high signal).. Acute ischemia restricts water diffusion and is typically bright on DWI (with appropriate ADC correlation). Reference: https://www.radiologyinfo.org/en/info/mri; https://cs.acr.org/-/media/ACR/Files/Radiology-Safety/MR-Safety/Manual-on-MR-Safety.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
